Style: a bold, simple illustration that will be displayed TINY as a framed picture on an office wall in a pixel art game (smaller than 64 pixels wide). A pixel art scene of a calm, empty, minimal modern office interior in soft late-afternoon light, in top-down 3/4 view like a cozy management game. Pale oak wooden floor boards; a quiet lounge corner with a low linen-beige sofa, moss green cushions and a round woven rug; two islands of pale oak desks with glowing soft blue monitors, keyboards and clay mugs, charcoal office chairs pushed in; potted plants in clay terracotta pots; low open oak shelves with a few stoneware vases and neutral boxes; a water cooler with a pale jug; a small oak coffee counter. Big windows along the back wall with thin charcoal frames and rice-paper panels show a pale peach sky over soft distant green hills. Warm paper lamp light pools on the floor. Calm, quiet, uncluttered atmosphere, nobody there: no people, no characters, no animals.

Style: authentic pixel art made of crisp hard-edged square pixels on a perfectly regular grid, limited palette, flat color fills with 3-4 shades per material, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur, no noise, no dithering. Calm, minimal, airy modern office pixel art with its own original look, warm and quiet: pale oak wood (#c9a77c), warm rice-paper off-white walls and panels (#f3eee4), soft linen beige fabrics (#dccdb4), muted moss green plants and cushions (#7c8b5a), matte charcoal metal and lamps (#3a3a3a), clay terracotta pots and small accents (#b8735a), light stone grey (#a9a49a); very few objects, lots of calm empty space. Original artwork: do not copy or imitate any existing game, tileset or artist. Outlines in dark blue-grey (#2b3245), never pure black. Light comes from the top-left. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermark.
